start: HQ open in a browser tab, signed in; two new leads came from the website and one gym owner says they paid

steps.action: Look at the menu and the browser tab while on any HQ page
user_sees: A red number '3' on 'Needs you' in the side menu (phone: on the bottom bar)
Tab title '(3) MettleUp HQ'
must_not: New feedback to read counted in the red number
The number shown while it is 0

user_sees: Heading 'Needs you'
'3 things to do. Tap one to open it.'
Lines '2 new leads to call' and '1 payment to confirm'
must_not: A line with a count of 0
The page total different from the menu number

user_sees: The Leads page opens
must_not: The count stays the same a minute after the leads are marked Called

start: Needs you page, alerts never asked for in this browser; HQ then left open in a background tab

steps.action: In the card 'Alerts' tap 'Turn on alerts' and allow notifications
user_sees: 'Alerts are on.' and a short sound
must_not: The browser asking again on every visit

steps.action: Switch to another tab; a new lead arrives on the website
user_sees: Within a minute a short sound and a pop-up 'MettleUp HQ: needs you' with '1 new lead to call'
The tab title number goes up
must_not: A pop-up for something that did not go up
Two pop-ups for the same new lead

user_sees: HQ comes to the front on the Leads page
must_not: HQ opens on a page unrelated to the line in the pop-up

start: Needs you page while Cloudflare's small database (leads, feedback) cannot be read, in a browser that blocks notifications

user_sees: Warning 'One part of this list could not be counted right now. The rest is up to date.'
Lines for gyms and payments still shown
must_not: Leads shown as nothing waiting with no warning

user_sees: 'Alerts are blocked in this browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser’s settings to get them.'
must_not: A 'Turn on alerts' button that does nothing

steps.action: Open HQ in a browser that has no notifications at all
user_sees: 'This browser cannot show pop-ups. HQ still shows the number on the menu and in the tab title.'

start: Needs you shows '1 new lead to call' and 2 new feedback messages to read

steps.action: Mark the lead Called on Leads, come back to 'Needs you' and wait up to a minute
user_sees: 'Nothing to do. Only new feedback to read.'
The line '2 new feedback messages to read'
The red number hidden; tab title 'MettleUp HQ'

steps.action: Mark the feedback read; wait a minute
user_sees: Card 'All clear' and 'HQ checks again every minute.'
'Nothing is waiting. New leads, feedback, gyms and payments show here.'
must_not: The page redrawn while typing in a box on it

start: The read log of direct looks at gym data has stopped working

user_sees: A red line on top 'Read log is not working since <time>: <reason>. Supabase keeps its logs only about a day, so direct looks at gym data are not being recorded. Fix it today.'
must_not: The red line missing while looks go unrecorded

user_sees: The same read log line counted in 'things to do'
must_not: Gym names, member names or phone numbers in the pop-up or the list (counts only)
